pageDesc: Issuing Mozambican passports and registering births and deaths for citizens in Germany and accredited countries.
passportIssuanceDesc: Apply for a new Mozambican passport or renew an existing one. Our consular staff will guide you through the entire application process, from document preparation to collection.
passportDetail1: New passport applications for adults and minors
passportDetail2: Renewal of expired or expiring passports
passportDetail3: Emergency travel documents for urgent cases
passportDetail4: Name changes and corrections on existing passports
civilRegistrationDesc: Register important civil events for Mozambican citizens abroad. Our office provides official registration services recognized by Mozambican authorities.
civilDetail3: Consular registration for citizens residing in Germany
birthRegistrationDesc: Register the birth of children born to Mozambican parents in Germany or accredited countries. Essential for dual citizenship and legal recognition.
birthDetail1: Birth certificates for children of Mozambican nationals
deathRegistrationDesc: Official registration of deaths for Mozambican citizens residing abroad. Essential for legal proceedings, inheritance, and repatriation.
idRenewalDesc: Renew or apply for a Mozambican National Identity Card (Bilhete de Identidade). Required for all Mozambican citizens over 16 years of age.
idDetail1: First-time ID applications for citizens abroad
idDetail2: Renewal of expired or damaged identity cards
idDetail3: Replacement of lost or stolen ID cards
step1: 1. Contact the Embassy to schedule an appointment or submit your request
step2: 2. Prepare required documents (identification, civil status documents, etc.)
step4: 4. Pay the required fees via bank transfer
step5: 5. Collect your documents at the scheduled time
contactSchedule: Contact us to schedule your appointment →
